title: Salary Breakdown by Gender
description: For each department_id, calculate the total salary paid to male employees ('M') and female employees ('F'). Return department_id, male_salary, and female_salary. If a department has no employees of a given gender, return 0.
solutionQuery: SELECT department_id, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS male_salary, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS female_salary FROM Employee GROUP BY department_id;
explanation: Use conditional aggregation with SUM and CASE expressions to pivot gender salary totals by department.
